is a 5 row by 5 column slot with dropping symbols that can expand up to 8 rows by 8 columns. Exposing and triggering breaking points under the symbols advances the game to expanded symbol grids from 5x5 to 6x6, 7x7 and finally 8x8.

Core game features are: The four beavers that move around on the grid collecting fruit symbols and feature symbols, the feature meter that counts up as paying symbols are collected and adds a pending feature symbol release once the meter is full, hidden features under the symbol grid that are activated when fully revealed, the Beaver Night Fever mini bonus game when clearing all the floorboards on a floor level, and finally the free drops bonus game.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
Super Bonus: Guarantees a game round with entry to the bonus game starting at floor level 3 with all paying symbols upgraded to payout level 3 at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
